001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Five-minute Control-IQ model record, written in the same pump second as opcode 227
009 * ({@code ControlIQCycleHistoryLog}) and always at that record's sequence number + 1 (10,025 of
010 * 10,025 pairs, ten t:slim X2 and Mobi pumps). It holds the algorithm's filtered glucose, a
011 * short-horizon glucose prediction, its adaptive total daily insulin (TDI) estimate and, only on
012 * Control-IQ+ Mobis with Control-IQ disabled, a TDI-derived correction factor. 227 carries 8-bit
013 * copies of three of these: its byte 20 is {@link #getFilteredGlucose()} capped at 255, its byte
014 * 22 is {@link #getTdiEstimate()} and its byte 21 equals {@link #getCorrectionFactor()} whenever
015 * that is non-zero.
016 *
017 * Written on both Control-IQ and non-Control-IQ pumps, with or without a CGM. After a pump
018 * reboot the record starts from TDI = the Control-IQ TDI setting, filtered glucose 31 and
019 * prediction 20.00 mg/dL until CGM readings arrive. On Control-IQ v7.6 Mobi firmware with
020 * Control-IQ disabled every byte is 0. A t:slim X2 firmware from early 2022 writes 227 but not
021 * this record.
022 *
023 * These are pump-internal Control-IQ values: do not use them for dosing or IOB.
024 *
025 * The class name is provisional: opcode 327 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
026 * app's history log list. Bytes 11-13, 18-19 and 21-25 were 0 in every observed record and are
027 * exposed raw.
028 */
029@HistoryLogProps(
030    opCode = 327,
031    displayName = "Control-IQ Glucose Model"
032)
033public class ControlIQGlucoseModelHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
034
035    private int tdiEstimate;
036    private int unknown11;
037    private int unknown12;
038    private int shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw;
039    private int filteredGlucose;
040    private int unknown18;
041    private int correctionFactor;
042    private int unknown21;
043    private int unknown22;
044    private int unknown24;
045
046    public ControlIQGlucoseModelHistoryLog() {}
047    public ControlIQGlucoseModelHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int tdiEstimate, int unknown11, int unknown12, int shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw, int filteredGlucose, int unknown18, int correctionFactor, int unknown21, int unknown22, int unknown24) {
048        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
049        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, tdiEstimate, unknown11, unknown12, shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw, filteredGlucose, unknown18, correctionFactor, unknown21, unknown22, unknown24);
050        this.tdiEstimate = tdiEstimate;
051        this.unknown11 = unknown11;
052        this.unknown12 = unknown12;
053        this.shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw = shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw;
054        this.filteredGlucose = filteredGlucose;
055        this.unknown18 = unknown18;
056        this.correctionFactor = correctionFactor;
057        this.unknown21 = unknown21;
058        this.unknown22 = unknown22;
059        this.unknown24 = unknown24;
060    }
061
062    public int typeId() {
063        return 327;
064    }
065
066    /**
067     * <table border="1">
068     * <caption>Parsed fields for ControlIQGlucoseModelHistoryLog:</caption>
069     * <tr><td><code>tdiEstimate</code></td><td><code>raw[10] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
070     * <tr><td><code>unknown11</code></td><td><code>raw[11] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
071     * <tr><td><code>unknown12</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
072     * <tr><td><code>shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
073     * <tr><td><code>filteredGlucose</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
074     * <tr><td><code>unknown18</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
075     * <tr><td><code>correctionFactor</code></td><td><code>raw[20] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
076     * <tr><td><code>unknown21</code></td><td><code>raw[21] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
077     * <tr><td><code>unknown22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
078     * <tr><td><code>unknown24</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 24)</code></td></tr>
079     * </table>
080     */
081    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
082        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
083        this.cargo = raw;
084        parseBase(raw);
085        this.tdiEstimate = raw[10] & 0xFF;
086        this.unknown11 = raw[11] & 0xFF;
087        this.unknown12 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
088        this.shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
089        this.filteredGlucose = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
090        this.unknown18 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 18);
091        this.correctionFactor = raw[20] & 0xFF;
092        this.unknown21 = raw[21] & 0xFF;
093        this.unknown22 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 22);
094        this.unknown24 = Bytes.readShort(raw, 24);
095    }
096
097    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int tdiEstimate, int unknown11, int unknown12, int shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw, int filteredGlucose, int unknown18, int correctionFactor, int unknown21, int unknown22, int unknown24) {
098        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
099            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(327, 0),
100            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
101            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
102            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(tdiEstimate),
103            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown11),
104            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown12),
105            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw),
106            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(filteredGlucose),
107            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown18),
108            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(correctionFactor),
109            Bytes.firstByteLittleEndian(unknown21),
110            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown22),
111            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(unknown24)));
112    }
113
114    /**
115     * The integer part of Control-IQ's adaptive total daily insulin estimate. On Mobis it equals
116     * floor() of the new estimate in the AA TDI Estimate Change record (332) written hourly in
117     * the same second (4,426 of 4,426 records, two pumps); t:slim X2s change it in hourly 1-3 unit
118     * steps without writing 332. After a reboot it restarts from the Control-IQ TDI setting.
119     *
120     * @return the TDI estimate in whole units per day (0 when the record is all zero)
121     */
122    public int getTdiEstimate() {
123        return tdiEstimate;
124    }
125
126    /**
127     * Always 0 observed; possibly the high byte of {@link #getTdiEstimate()}.
128     *
129     * @return raw uint8 at offset 11
130     */
131    public int getUnknown11() {
132        return unknown11;
133    }
134
135    /**
136     * Always 0 observed.
137     *
138     * @return raw uint16 at offset 12
139     */
140    public int getUnknown12() {
141        return unknown12;
142    }
143
144    /**
145     * A glucose prediction in hundredths of mg/dL, with a shorter horizon than the one in 227
146     * bytes 14-15: (227 prediction - filtered glucose) = 1.85 x (this - filtered glucose),
147     * R&sup2; 0.985-0.995 on three CGM pumps. With a CGM it follows the trend of
148     * {@link #getFilteredGlucose()}; without one it falls below it as insulin on board rises.
149     * Control-IQ's basal and auto-bolus thresholds (112.5 and 180 mg/dL) line up with 227's
150     * prediction, not this one. The horizon is not known (roughly 15 minutes is a guess).
151     * Floor 2000 (20.00 mg/dL).
152     *
153     * @return the raw uint16 at offset 14, mg/dL x 100
154     */
155    public int getShortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw() {
156        return shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw;
157    }
158
159    /**
160     * @return {@link #getShortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw()} in mg/dL
161     */
162    public double getShortTermPredictedGlucoseMgdl() {
163        return shortTermPredictedGlucoseRaw / 100.0;
164    }
165
166    /**
167     * Control-IQ's filtered current glucose. With a CGM it follows the latest reading
168     * (r 0.996-0.9998, mean absolute difference 1.3-2.6 mg/dL, four pumps) and is fitted by
169     * 0.38 x previous value + 0.62 x latest reading + 0.25 x previous change (R&sup2; above 0.999).
170     * Not capped at 255, unlike 227 byte 20. Without a CGM it holds a pump-dependent value; after
171     * a reboot it starts at 31.
172     *
173     * @return the filtered glucose in mg/dL (uint16 at offset 16)
174     */
175    public int getFilteredGlucose() {
176        return filteredGlucose;
177    }
178
179    /**
180     * Always 0 observed.
181     *
182     * @return raw uint16 at offset 18
183     */
184    public int getUnknown18() {
185        return unknown18;
186    }
187
188    /**
189     * A correction factor derived from the TDI estimate, filled only on Control-IQ+ Mobis with
190     * Control-IQ disabled; 0 on every t:slim X2 record and on Mobis with Control-IQ enabled.
191     * Equal to floor(1800 / TDI estimate) in all 4,425 such records from 2026 on two pumps, capped
192     * on one of them at a value equal to its profile ISF. Eight other non-zero records fit
193     * floor(1500 / TDI estimate) instead, so the constant is not settled.
194     *
195     * @return the correction factor in mg/dL per unit, or 0 when not filled
196     */
197    public int getCorrectionFactor() {
198        return correctionFactor;
199    }
200
201    /**
202     * Always 0 observed.
203     *
204     * @return raw uint8 at offset 21
205     */
206    public int getUnknown21() {
207        return unknown21;
208    }
209
210    /**
211     * Always 0 observed.
212     *
213     * @return raw uint16 at offset 22
214     */
215    public int getUnknown22() {
216        return unknown22;
217    }
218
219    /**
220     * Always 0 observed.
221     *
222     * @return raw uint16 at offset 24
223     */
224    public int getUnknown24() {
225        return unknown24;
226    }
227}
